stories.title: Global nature talks reach deal but money remains an issue
stories.brief: Countries have been trying to get a global agreement to halt nature decline back on track.

stories.title: Bute House protested by environmental campaigners
stories.brief: A Halloween-themed protest against fossil fuels has targeted the first minister's residence in Edinburgh.

stories.title: US tech stocks see sharp falls as AI spending nears $1tn
stories.brief: Shares in Intel continue to fall while the tech-heavy Nasdaq opens at its lowest level in more than two months.

stories.title: PHC seeks replies from governor, speaker against governor’s rule
stories.brief: The petitions, filed in the Peshawar High Court by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan and others, contend that the imposition of emergency in certain districts and governor’s rule in others is unconstitutional and illegal. The high court will take up the petitions for further hearing on November 10.

stories.title: Pakistan rebukes Afghan Taliban's 'deeply misguided approach' to resolving bilateral tensions
stories.brief: Islamabad has repeatedly urged the Afghan Taliban administration to prevent terrorist organisations, particularly the TTP, from using its territory to launch attacks inside Pakistan.

stories.title: Syria weighing whether to join Makkah pact: foreign minister
stories.brief: Syria’s Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani on Saturday said Damascus was considering whether to join the Makkah defence pact that binds Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye. Pakistan is providing “whatever support is needed” to defend Saudi Arabia amid the Houthi attacks, the military’s spokesperson Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry said earlier this month.

stories.title: UK PM 'open' to slavery apology but not reparations
stories.brief: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Saturday he was “open” to the UK issuing a formal apology for its role in the transatlantic slave trade, but ruled out financial reparations. Britain’s central role in slavery and the treatment of people in its former colonies has loomed over the 77-year-old monarch’s Caribbean tour.

stories.title: Syria says discussions underway on joining Makkah Defence Alliance
stories.brief: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani said on Saturday that "discussions are currently underway to evaluate Syria's entry into the Makkah alliance", a regional pact that brings together Türkiye, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia. Shaibani’s remarks came during a regional security session at the Manama Dialogue 2026, according to the Syrian Arab News Agency (SANA).

stories.title: Police constable martyred, two injured in firing at Lakki Marwat judicial complex
stories.brief: A police constable was martyred and two other people were injured when unidentified gunmen opened fire outside the courtroom of an additional sessions judge inside the Judicial Complex in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's (K-P's) Lakki Marwat on Saturday.

stories.title: UK PM Burnham says he is 'open' to formal apology for slavery, but rules out reparations
stories.brief: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he was open to calls for a formal apology for Britain's historical role in slavery, ​before attending next week's Commonwealth summit at which he is likely ‌to face demands for financial reparations.

stories.title: PM criticises PTI's 13-year rule in K-P, urges PML-N leadership to prioritise public welfare projects
stories.brief: While criticising PTI, the prime minister said political slogans and divisive politics had taken precedence over public service, while problems in Peshawar, Kohistan, Hazara and the southern districts remained unaddressed.

stories.title: Anti-encroachment drive will continue regardless of political influence, says Talal
stories.brief: The remarks came a day after the Capital Development Authority (CDA) issued an encroachment notice at Fazl's residence, identifying illegal constructions and encroachments on its land and directing their removal within 15 days.

stories.title: Chelsea beat Man United as Martinez sent off to pile pressure on Carrick
stories.brief: Goals from Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer give Chelsea a 2-0 win over Manchester United in the Premier League.

stories.title: Why North Korea's 'elite' hackers are the prime suspect in major Binance hack
stories.brief: If the accusations are true, the record-making heist shows how powerful suspected North Korean hackers have become.

stories.title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
stories.brief: The cyber-attack, which the company describes as complex, is believed to be the largest ever of its kind.

stories.title: Tech sell-off drives US markets down by nearly $1tn after subpar earnings reports
stories.brief: It was on track to erase its gain for October, even though it set its all-time high during the same month. The weakness for technology stocks dragged the Nasdaq composite down even further, more than 3%, also erasing hundreds of billions in value.

stories.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as its own AI search hits ad sales
stories.brief: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI own search summaries were affecting ad revenue.

stories.title: Crypto giant Binance hit by $6.3bn hack suspected to be largest in history
stories.brief: Two analytics firms have attributed the incident to a North Korean hacking unit called TraderTraitor.

stories.title: ‘Very little, if anything, done for KP’: PM Shehbaz rails against PTI’s governance in province
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Saturday criticised PTI’s governance in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, questioning whether the funds available to the now dysfunctional provincial government had been used transparently for the welfare and betterment of the people of the province.
